title: Choose the visual world for Storefront
question: The roll assigned the Railway Reservation world. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Railway Reservation
options.lineage: Indian Railways PRS tickets, station name boards and reservation charts
options.thesis: Buying Pro is booking a seat: every licence is a ticket with a PNR you keep.
options.viewport: A yellow station board names the suite; below, a ticket-card booking form for the chosen app, fare in tabular figures, Book with UPI as the one red action.
options.risk: Can read as costume if the ticket grammar decorates instead of structuring the form, key and admin chart.

raised.raise: Red is rationed to the single booking action on each screen, nothing else.
Every fare, PNR, date and KPI set in tabular mono figures; numbers are the instrument.
Hierarchy by scale contrast alone: huge board lettering vs tiny ticket labels, no gradients or glows.
State is physical: a paid ticket gets punched (notch + stamp), a chosen app lifts off the chart.

options.label: Stamp Sheet
options.lineage: India Post commemorative stamp sheets and postmarks
options.thesis: The nine terracotta app icons already are stamps: the catalog is one perforated sheet, the pass is the whole sheet.
options.viewport: A perforated sheet of nine app stamps with denominations in ₹; tearing one off opens its Buy form; the licence arrives postmarked.
options.risk: Cream ground plus terracotta sits close to the common AI look; needs the perforation and postmark grammar at full strength to escape it.

options.label: Agit-Train
options.thesis: Each app a railcar broadside driven by a red wedge.
options.viewport: A diagonal red wedge carries the buy action across the catalog.
options.case: Foreign to Indian dev buyers and diagonals fight form clarity on phones.
options.kept: Red rationed to the one action that drives the page.
options.risk: Political-propaganda register clashes with a plain, honest voice.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: Each purchase as a track out of one collision.
options.viewport: Concentric rings with apps as tracks.
options.case: Spectacle without a buyer's reason; hides price and action.
options.risk: Near-black plus neon is a saturated look.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: The catalog as a specimen of nine names.
options.viewport: One giant app name morphing on a slider.
options.case: Elegant but says nothing about licences or rupees.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone, no ornament.

options.label: Kinetic Sand
options.thesis: Apps as glyphs on a rotating ring.
options.case: No tie to audience; rotation hides the catalog.
options.kept: State as a physical change, not a colour swap.
options.risk: Heavy canvas rendering on budget phones.

options.label: Akari Workshop
options.case: Japanese craft world, not the buyer's.
options.kept: One stamp mark as the active state.
options.risk: Cream and vermilion is the common AI look.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean indie-software store: white, near-black, one blue, app grid.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, subcopy, Buy button, grid of app cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every Gumroad/Lemon Squeezy store by design.
